none: PAS LVPL-DE5B47: Roman Republican Denarius of the moneyer Valerius Flaccus (108/107BC)
contea di ritrovamento: Denbighshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman Republican Denarius of the moneyer Valerius Flaccus (108/107BC). Obverse has a draped bust of Victory with a 6-point star beneath her chin. The reverse is standing figure of Mars walking left holding a spear and trophy over his shoulder. The motifs in front of him and behind him are damaged, but would have been an apex (conical hat with a spike) in front of him with the legend L VALERI…
